items.author: BTC_Alert_
items.new_information: 三类冻结的区别及超范围冻结解除路径

evidence.quote: 司法冻结：经币安执法请求系统 LERS 或国际司法协助，这个一般是6个月的冻结期，经过请求协助的机构统一方可解冻，可无限续冻。
平台风控冻结：币安 KYT、AML 系统，这种一般是由币安风控冻结，如快进快出，跑分等。币安合规部门一般
要你提交资金来源证明，没问题的话很快几天到一周。
发行方黑名单：Tether、Circle联合bn冻结，一般是发行方链上标记，赎回系统标记（u-usd），交易所联合，黑客事件就是采取这种方式。
在司法文书中被冻的不是“某笔 U”，而是账户这个主体。
但，法律上超范围冻结是可以申请解除的，这个需要律师找到涉案的办理单位，经过法律手段找到最大可能涉案值进行磋商，再由办理单位出具文书，币安就可以操作了。

evidence.quote: TLDR：现货和永续，一个站在资产负债表上负责确权和分红，一个站在流量层负责杠杆、做空和连续定价，实际上，互补的意义大于对立。
第一，现货代币化解决的是确权，不是流动性。不管是 @The_DTCC 接入 Solana，还是 OKXICE 的白名单池，本质上都是把合法持股搬进链上账户，但绕不开两道门：发行方可以拒绝授权（OKXICE 首批接洽的 62 家公司里有 56 家拒绝了），加上合规和 KYC 隔离，甚至 Aave V4 支持代币化股票做抵押时，周末喂价也要停在周五收盘。
第二，休市时段的价格发现权，依然留在永续手里。看下 @PythNetwork 的 10 月报告就知道差距：美股永续的周成交量是链上代币化现货的 63 倍，前 25 只美股永续差不多一半（49.8%）的成交都发生在休市时段。像 @tradexyz 这类链上永续，周末也是靠自己的订单簿在连续定价。

evidence.quote: Today I'm excited to announce Nex, our new exchange built from the ground up.

We've been sprinting on it since August. A Nex instance has been running in shadow mode on production traffic for the last week, side by side with the current exchange. It mirrors every order the current exchange gets, so we can measure latency, stability under load, and validate matching correctness against live production flow.
The numbers below are internal exchange timings, not e2e (those are coming soon), but we wanted to show how big the difference is.
- Place order: 1.55s → 3.76ms (412x faster)

Scale: The current CLOB in stable state can handle 10k commands/s with 15k bursts → Nex can handle 100k commands/s with 150k bursts. 10x more, and with a few optimisations we can get to 200k commands/s with 250k bursts; with more low-level core changes, we can get to 1M commands/s over the next year. Not needed yet, but the headroom is there.
We wanted to build this without any breaking changes for MMs or builders; Nex has no breaking changes to requests or responses, so we just need to swap out the binary on our side and it will go live.

We'll run 4 weeks of shadow mode on production traffic to make sure everything is perfect, then if everything is good, we will go live mid-December. We can roll out WebSocket improvements without the full exchange, so we may do that sooner.

items.new_information: 初版仅隐藏金额，自定义电路需可信设置

evidence.quote: Helius takes a more focused, minimalistic approach. The core protocol defines a set of explicit SNARK circuits that encapsulate some functionality - like a private send, or a private swap. To assemble private transactions, devs take these circuits and combine them like lego bricks to build out more complicated transaction flows.

A noteworthy point about their architecture is that Helius uses Groth16 proofs, which require circuit-specific trusted setups. Asking developers to run their own setup if they need custom functionality pushes a substantial security requirement onto them. Particularly in the age of AI where an increasing avalanche of CVEs means it’s harder to know the code

Compliance and shutting out bad actors is a shared challenge and I am interested in seeing how Helius will approach it. Their initial deployment of Privacy Rings does not hide the transaction graph, and only hides transfer values. This is a weak form of privacy, but it looks like they will add more advanced rings soon that do hide the transaction graph. At

complexity comes with its own tradeoffs. For more complex needs, edge cases and novel designs not covered by the stock Groth16 circuits, Helius pushes more complexity onto the developer and requires them to successfully execute trusted setups, which adds what I would consider to be a substantial security risk, although that is my subjective opinion.
